sloka: ककुभः ककुभ ऊरुम् ताम् व्यक्तम् जानाति मैथिलीम् ।लता पल्लव पुष्प आढ्यो भाति हि एष वनस्पतिः ॥३-६०-१५॥
transliteration: kakubhaḥ kakubha ūrum tām vyaktam jānāti maithilīm ।latā pallava puṣpa āḍhyo bhāti hi eṣa vanaspatiḥ ॥3-60-15॥

translations.english: This Kakubha tree rich with tender leaves and flowers (perhaps)knows Maithili whose thighs are beautiful like the trunk of the Kakubha tree.
